title: Matching One Scan to Another: Iterating Nearest Points to a Rigid Move, Where It Converges, and the Corridor It Cannot Tell Anything About

artifact.note: the iterative closest point match of one set of 2D points to another: pair each point with its nearest within a distance, find the rotation and translation that best put the pairs together in the least squares sense in closed form, move, and repeat until the move is small
